subject: Evaluation kickoff & trial plan — scheduling and success criteria
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cornerstonehealth.com>, Natalie Park <natalie.park@cornerstonehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation kickoff & trial plan — scheduling and success criteria

Hi Liam / Natalie —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking us through Cornerstone's primary use cases and constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the trial moving: 

Recap from discovery:
- Primary workloads: clinical note summarization (latency sensitive) and semantic search over care protocols (batch embeddings).
- Target SLOs: p95 < 500ms for short summaries, and embedding throughput for nightly jobs.
- Data controls: VPC/private deployment desired for PHI-sensitive routes; SOC2 evidence required.
- Success signals: accuracy vs. human baseline on our prompt set + sustained throughput at target cost profile.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60–75 minute evaluation kickoff (demo + technical deep dive) to align on trial plan, success criteria, and a first-pass prompt set/evals. Suggested times (PDT):
- Thu Mar 18 — 10:00–11:15
- Fri Mar 19 — 14:00–15:15

If those don't work, share a couple windows or use the Calendly link below. For the kickoff please include: 
- Product/engineering stakeholders (for network/firewall questions)
- Security/compliance (to review SOC2 & network architecture)
- A technical SME who will run the prompt set validation during the trial

Attached: 2026-03-15_Redwood_Eval_Plan.pdf (high-level trial plan + timeline).
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/60min-eval-kickoff

Ask: could you please: 1) confirm preferred slot, 2) share any immediate success criteria (even rough), and 3) send 3–5 representative prompts/examples we should include in the eval set?

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
